title: Quantitative discovery
purpose: Cheap and fast. Sharpen where qualitative research should go. This phase maps WHERE drop-off concentrates — not WHY.
north_star: Wishlist / consideration → purchase conversion on Myntra
output: Segmented drop-off map: category × price band × user tenure × wishlist-size bucket, with funnel and diagnostic metrics. Spend interview budget on the densest cells.
status_note: Requires Myntra product analytics (wishlist lifecycle, price/stock snapshots, search, cart). Public reviews cannot compute these rates.

workstreams.title: Wishlist funnel decomposition
workstreams.job: % of wishlisted items that are never revisited / revisited but not purchased / purchased on Myntra / removed without purchase.
workstreams.grain: Item (user × style × size × color), windows 7 / 30 / 90 days from add.

workstreams.title: Time-to-purchase distribution
workstreams.job: For converters: is time-to-purchase front-loaded (decisive) or long-tail (deliberators)? Report p50 / p90 + histogram.
workstreams.grain: Converted items only; cut by category.

workstreams.title: Size / color / stock at add vs later
workstreams.job: How many would-be conversions die because the saved size/color went OOS or the style delisted.
workstreams.grain: Non-converters who revisit or open PDP from wishlist.

workstreams.title: Price trajectory (sale-wait test)
workstreams.job: Did price drop, rise, or stay flat for converters vs non-converters? Tests waiting-for-a-sale directly.
workstreams.grain: Price at add vs convert or last revisit / window end.

workstreams.title: Wishlist size vs conversion
workstreams.job: Do power-wishlisters (100+ items) convert worse than light wishlisters (5–10)? Tests bookmarking vs genuine intent.
workstreams.grain: User-level conversion of their wishlisted items.

workstreams.title: Revisit pattern
workstreams.job: How many wishlist page/item opens before buy or give-up. Zero revisits = forgetting. Many revisits + no buy = active deliberation.
workstreams.grain: Item-level reopen count between add and outcome.

workstreams.title: Category cuts
workstreams.job: Occasion-wear (ethnic, party) vs basics (tees, innerwear). Occasion is hypothesized as event-driven; basics as habitual/low-risk.
workstreams.grain: Same metrics as funnel, split by category family.

workstreams.title: Search / browse before drop-off
workstreams.job: Right before dropping a wishlisted item: same-item reviews, competing products, or neither?

workstreams.title: Cart vs wishlist abandonment
workstreams.job: Is wishlist worse than cart, or comparable? Wishlist-specific problem vs general purchase hesitation.
workstreams.grain: Same users, same window, carted vs wishlisted items.
